purpose: Separate ordinary upstream timeouts and empty or out-of-band results from whole-stage setup failure while retaining every preplanned acquisition slot and outcome. This is an acquisition-method amendment only; it does not claim quality or qualify the current candidate.

execution.ordinary_failure_policy: continue every already-planned operation exactly once after a sealed request timeout, empty pool, wrong natural-size band, or navigation target miss; seal each outcome and the complete 13-operation inventory; the stage remains inconclusive and is ineligible for capture, grading, or a quality decision
execution.pool_failure: retain empty, failed, wrong-band and overflow outcomes; stage inconclusive, no replacement/concatenation/trimming
execution.timeout_scope: The supported shared SearchService request deadline is 30 seconds. Redirects and all engines for a query share that logical deadline; this profile does not promise two full 30-second physical requests within one query.
hard_stop: stage deadline or configured stage budget
physical call, request material, response body, aggregate transfer, or result-count cap
provider rate limit, access denial, blocked or unavailable provider, or non-timeout provider error
unexpected endpoint, redirect, credential, scope, parser/control identity, or operation binding
lease, receipt, snapshot, filesystem, serialization, or fsync failure

unchanged_study_contract.cohorts: The same full 8 research cases, balanced four per natural-size band, plus five exact navigation targets per stage.
unchanged_study_contract.search_plan: Preserve exact task queries, engine mixes, complete naturally observed pools, no trim, split, replacement, concatenation, or rescue.
unchanged_study_contract.gates: All registered source, ranking, usefulness, task-use, stability, navigation, resource, and 8-hour stage gates remain unchanged. Every required case must be complete; invoked-but-inconclusive cases are retained and do not qualify for grading.
unchanged_study_contract.legacy_v1: Existing coverage-live-acquisition-manifest/1 remains 10-second fail-fast with its existing byte format and interpretation. This draft does not reinterpret, replay, repair, or rescue any terminal v1 stage.
unchanged_study_contract.previous_attempts: The terminal 2026-10-12 acquisition attempt remains preserved and is not reused, retried, regraded, or upgraded by this draft. Any new stage requires a separately reviewed and registered protocol, source closure, cohort/protocol pins, fresh stage identity, and new one-shot permits before calls.

registration_requirements: Version and pin the amended protocol and executable source closure before any new stage.
Bind this exact profile id and all fixed values into the acquisition manifest, external permit receipt, execution-control attestation, snapshot artifacts, resource collector, and stage registration.
Retain all 13 operation rows and all physical exchange receipts. Ordinary failures may continue only into already planned operations; no retries or new query plans are created.
The unchanged coordinator must refuse downstream capture and grading unless the entire acquisition is complete and all existing admission conditions pass.
A sealed inconclusive stage is evidence of execution only and cannot count toward the quality or adoption decision.
qualification: Not registered, not admitted, not executed, and not a quality result. No provider calls were made while preparing this draft.
